## Description

Two faces meet along a shared edge that is C0 (a sharp crease) on part of its length and G1 (smooth) on the rest. Offset must produce different surface types for each subsection. Bug-reporter language: "mixed connectivity offset", "edge partly smooth partly sharp".

## Reproducer recipe

Two B-spline faces sharing an edge whose tangent jump is zero on `t∈[0,0.5]` and non-zero on `t∈[0.5,1]`.

## Expected kernel behavior

Split the edge at the regularity transition; offset each segment independently.
